- Blackberries 34 g x 43 kcal/100g = 15 kcal
- Blueberries 13 g x 57 kcal/100g = 7 kcal

STEP 8 - Sanity check: a sparse scatter of berries covering about a quarter of a large plate, ~176 g and ~63 kcal, is plausible.
